The authored catalog audit records 7510 equipment variants, 7510 combined IDs and 0 current-patch-verified entries. These are repository counts, not live-database or full-game coverage. [Sources and formula provenance](DATA_SOURCES.md).

Foundation: Next.js/React/TypeScript with PostgreSQL/Prisma, Redis and standalone runtime. Discord provider/session code exists; real provider and HTTPS checks remain separate. Private GitHub repository policies have live evidence; repositories are empty and hosted CI has no execution evidence. [Full technical acceptance inventory](QA_CHECKLIST.md).

Historical checkpoints are preserved in [development history](docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md) and the [original-document archive](docs/history/README.md); they do not determine current status.
